meta.name: description
meta.content: As it stands today: the Sphinx Temple's core walls at uneven heights with its granite pillars gone, the roofless Valley Temple with its T-shaped hall of 16 granite pillars, the causeway foundation, and the pyramids without their casing. Sphinx-local metres: x east, y up from the enclosure floor (19.95 m ASL), z south. A simulacrum, not a survey.
